definitions.explanation: Physical currency as opposed to credit.

examples.japanese: {現金|げんきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
{現金|げんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていない→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I don't have cash on me.

examples.japanese: ATM⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{現金|げんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろした→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧。
examples.english: I withdrew cash from the ATM.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧お⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}えない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{現金|げんきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This shop doesn't accept cards, so you need cash.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{現金|げんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧、⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧マネー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, fewer people use cash and more people pay with electronic money.

notes:
{現金|げんきん} refers to physical currency (bills and coins) as opposed to digital or credit-based payments.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{現|げん}→現〜：03950_gen⟧: present, current, actual
- {金|きん}: money, gold

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {現金|げんきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay in cash)
- {現金|げんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧ (to withdraw cash)
- {現金|げんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧ (to withdraw cash - colloquial)
- {現金|げんきん}⟦{払|はら}い→払い：noentry⟧ (cash payment)
- {現金|げんきん}⟦のみ→のみ：noentry⟧ (cash only)

CONTRAST WITH OTHER PAYMENT METHODS:
- {現金|げんきん}: cash (physical money)
- ⟦クレジットカード→クレジットカード：06968_kurejittokaado⟧: credit card
- ⟦{電子|でんし}マネー→電子マネー：06694_denshimanee⟧: electronic money (Suica, PayPay, etc.)
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{込|こ}み→振り込み：05421_furikomi⟧: bank transfer
- ⟦{小切手|こぎって}→小切手：06305_kogitte⟧: check

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has traditionally been a cash-heavy society, though digital payments have grown rapidly. Many small shops and restaurants still prefer {現金|げんきん}.
